contract.role: Garage is the local vehicle management home, not a second Home dashboard.
contract.header: Use the PicoRadar brand header with avatar and notification bell capsule.
contract.carousel: Native PageView carousel with substantial partial side vehicles and active vehicle as the initial focus.
contract.focusedVehicle: Swiping changes Garage focus only. It must not silently mutate the global active vehicle.

dataTruthExceptions: Do not show fake mileage before a Maintenance lot.
Do not show Sin comparendos or 0 comparendos before C14.

contract.favorites: Store favorite vehicle ids as local non-sensitive AppPreferences data; no Drift migration.
contract.addVehicle: Dashed Add Vehicle card opens the existing vehicle onboarding with return=garage.

quickActions.Detalle: Open the existing Garage vehicle detail for the focused vehicle.
quickActions.Documentos: Open the existing Documents module route with the focused vehicle id when available.
quickActions.Eliminar: Use confirmed delete semantics with active-vehicle fallback.

contract.accessibility: Icon controls have labels/tooltips and touch targets remain at least 48dp on Android.
contract.orientation: Portrait-only phone surface inherited from R02C.
contract.physicalQa: Mi A3 final render must show header, filters, carousel, info panel, add card, actions and bottom nav without overflow.
